entities.summary: Rifeh or Deir Rifeh is a village in Egypt. The name refers today most often to a series of ancient Egyptian cemeteries nearby. These are the burial grounds of the ancient town Shashotep. The cemeteries date from the end of the First Intermediate Period to the Roman Period. Especially important are the burials of the Middle Kingdom. Rifeh is a archaeological site from Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
